description:
`jit --schema` omits the real `rejected` lifecycle state and does not expose all accepted CLI spellings: visible aliases and global help/schema/version flags are absent. That makes the schema unsafe as a sole machine-readable CLI contract.

Source: `crates/jit/src/schema.rs:103-141,235-249,286-315,459-469`; `crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:19-42,75-101`; `crates/jit/src/cli.rs:20-36,978-987,1822-1828`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The schema represents every real `State` value, including `rejected`, from one authoritative enumeration.
- [hard] REQ-02: The schema exposes accepted visible aliases and all global help/schema/version flags in documented machine-readable form.
- [hard] REQ-03: Focused tests fail when a state, primary flag, alias, or global flag is omitted.
title: Complete the generated CLI schema contract
